claims.text: The paper synthesizes a definition of the metaverse from existing literature.
The paper delineates key affordances of the metaverse.
The paper introduces a framework encompassing the metaverse's nature, infrastructure technologies, and input/output technologies facilitating multi-sensory HCI.

evidence.description: We first synthesize a definition of the metaverse from existing literature and delineate key affordances.
We first synthesize a definition of the metaverse from existing literature and delineate key affordances.

We then introduce a detailed framework encompassing the metaverse’s nature, infrastructure technologies, and input/output technologies that facilitate multi-sensory HCI, alongside applications across diverse domains.

methodologies.name: Human-centric metaverse survey and framework synthesis
methodologies.description: A comprehensive review synthesizing existing literature to construct a framework detailing metaverse nature, infrastructure, and multi-sensory HCI input/output technologies.

limitations.text: There is a lack of surveys in existing literature that review the nature of the metaverse and its building blocks from a human-centric perspective.

future_work.text: Further exploration and investigation into major open challenges regarding metaverse infrastructure, input/output technologies, and human-centered multi-sensory interaction.
